newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal, Spain, Italy to fly nationals from Zaire.
newsitem.headline: Portugal, Spain, Italy to fly nationals from Zaire.

text.p: Portugal, Spain and Italy have jointly organised a flight to evacuate their nationals from northeastern Zaire on Sunday due to a "rapid deterioration" of the situation in the region, the Portuguese news agency said.

Lusa quoted foreign ministry sources as saying on Saturday that all Portuguese nationals in the region, estimated to be about 10, had been asked to be at Isiro airport on Sunday at 0830 hours local time.
The plane, which would evacuate nationals from the three countries to Kinshasa, was due to land at Isiro airport at 9 a.m. local time, it said.
The ministry recommended that the Portuguese nationals in the area should keep in touch with the Portuguese embassy in Kinshasa, Lusa reported.
Foreign ministry spokesmen were not immediately available.
On Friday, the Portuguese foreign ministry appealed to Portuguese nationals to leave the Isiro region as soon as possible because of fighting there.
The advice was aimed above all at Portuguese missionaries in the region, the ministry said.
Zaire's newly-formed crisis government has vowed to recover control of a swathe of East Zaire seized by rebels who are trying to topple the government of President Mobutu Sese Seko.
